label: Netgear Nighthawk M6 Pro 5G mmWave hotspot (MR6550)
description: 5G mmWave and sub-6 hotspot (MR6550) with one 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port and Wi-Fi 6E rated 3.6 Gbps aggregate (the 6 GHz band needs mains power and is indoor-only). Cellular runs over both mmWave and sub-6 carriers, carried here as the Ethernet-class interface wan5g.
